Poor ambient air quality may attract penalties and lead to cessation of operations by statutory authorities. It may also have a negative impact on the community including adverse health outcomes.

The company has installed adequate numbers of Air Pollution Control Devices (APCD), such as Gas Cleaning Plants (GCP), Dust Extraction Systems (DE), Mist Cannons, Rain Guns and Dry Fog Dust Suppression Systems (DFDS). Regular maintenance work is done on the equipment for optimum functionality. Ambient air quality is monitored in accordance with a schedule as per prescribed norms, and no negative feedback has been received by the company.
The fumes generated during tapping and hot metal handling may have harmful impacts on the working crew

All furnaces are fitted with Fume Extraction Systems and Mist Cannons to suppress fumes and dust. Reasonable levels of air ambience are being maintained and no negative feedback has been received by the company.
Release of wastewater may lead to statutory violations and may also have adverse impacts on the local community.

Wastewater from our operations is reused entirely, for cooling various equipment, suppressing dust, or for ash cooling. Domestic wastewater is treated through Sewage Treatment Plants (STP) and used for gardening. There is no discharge of wastewater.
Ash and slag produced during operations are environmental pollutants.

The Company has a fly ash brick manufacturing plant and Low Density Aggregate Plant that utilises the ash. Ash is also supplied to local brick manufacturing units, for road construction and to cement manufacturing units. Slag is utilised for internal road construction and filling low lying areas.
